title: Luckman: book's alien drawing matches a British Museum image
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Luckman: book's alien drawing matches a British Museum image, about 1970s at British Museum, London; New York, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I've sent you the photo. I've sent you the photo out of the British Museum. It's the It's exactly the being that it was drawn by.

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, relays a claim from Michael Luckman about a 1970s book called UFOs: Past, Present and Future, which was tied to Bob Emenegger and Alan Sandler. According to Cameron, a drawing of an alien in that book is exactly the same being as one shown in an image held at the British Museum in London, and he says he sent the host the photo. If true, it would suggest the same beings have been pictured since long ago.
